column1: # Root cause confirmed by direct experiment (see byroredux/src/render/mod.rs
# sort for true alpha-over transparency is the real mechanism, NOT the
# predicate is dormant on tested cells — blended&&two_sided==0 everywhere
# measured). Depth-primary order is the deliberate, correct cost of the
# #1804/#2237 compositing fix (stops a farther decal/puddle drawing after a
# nearer glass pane); accepted here as the new baseline, not chased further.
# captured at frame ~240 via byro-dbg telemetry, MAX_TOTAL_BONES=196608
# entities_total: ±2% tolerance metric, not exact (#1705 / RT-3). Benign creep
# from non-render bodies (collision/ragdoll/markers) is expected and within band;
# bench_draws_cmds is the exact render-load contract. --regen if it leaves ±2%.
